notes: Doodle brush: draw freehand on any image with adjustable colour, thickness and an eraser.
Mosaic brush: blur sensitive areas such as logos, faces or price tags with adjustable block size.
Doodle and mosaic are stored as separate layers, so they can be hidden, reordered or deleted at any time.
Editor now covers adjustments, filters, crop, rotate, undo, compare, text, stickers, doodle and mosaic.
